items.title: 'Utter nonsense': Cummins breaks silence on Khawaja's sandpaper scandal claims
items.author: AMIT KUMAR
items.description: Australia captain Pat Cummins has strongly denied claims made by Usman Khawaja regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Cummins asserted that he did not know about the plan and has consistently maintained that stance over the years. Khawaja's autobiography brought renewed attention to the incident, prompting severe reactions from Cummins. Despite the allegations, Cummins has decided against taking legal action and hopes to move on from this controversy.

items.title: Rupee streak trips on dollar demand, falls 35 paise to 94.04
items.description: The Indian rupee faltered on Thursday, settling at 94.04 per US dollar after shedding 35 paise from its previous value. The surge in dollar demand from nationalised banks and importers outweighed the early strengthening of the rupee. This push for dollars was influenced by unexpected inflation data from the US and upward trends in US treasury yields. Interestingly, foreign portfolio investors continued their buying spree, purchasing ₹7,830.
